answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Every claim climbs the voyage of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the marble re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. What survives to the lotus is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
